QuestInfo.name: Nix In Need
QuestInfo.1: #b#p2520021##k wants you to get rid of the monsters that are disrupting his reading.\r\n#b(Go out the portal on the right and eliminate all monsters.)#k
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated all the monsters that were disrupting #b#p2520021##k's reading. Why can't he do it himself?

0.0: I want to give you the book, but I need a favor. Just consider it a service for an old dragon.
0.1: There's just so many monsters around here disturbing my reading time! Eliminate the monsters outside that portal on your right. You can do that, yes?

yes.0: I like your attitude! I'll have that book ready when you get back.\r\n#b(Go out the portal on the right and eliminate all monsters.)#k

no.0: Just go back then. Poor Neinheart... What good does being smart do when his friends are so stingy? And yes, I'm talking about you.

default.0: I'll wait right here. \r\n#b(Go out the portal on the right and eliminate all monsters.)#k
